title: Grade 4 CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — 3.5 Jesus raises a Widow’s Son

pages.lesson:
PAGE 1: Overview

OVERVIEW
========

Luke 7:11-16 tells how Jesus met a funeral at the town of Nain and raised a widow's only son. In this sub-strand you will retell that miracle, recognise God's power over life and death, and learn to show compassion and to pray when life is hard. You will also recite John 11:25.

## Strand 3.0: The Life of Jesus Christ
Sub-strand 3.5: Jesus raises a Widow’s Son
Suggested lessons: 2

## Learning outcomes
By the end of the sub-strand, the learner should be able to:
a) retell the story of raising the widow’s son
b) recognise God’s power over life and death
c) apply lessons learnt by showing compassion to others
d) pray to God when faced with challenges

## Key inquiry questions
1. What do you learn from the miracle of raising the widow’s son?

## Core competencies
• Digital literacy: the skill of connecting parts of a digital device is exhibited as learners watch a video clip on raising the widow’s son.
• Self-efficacy: the skill of expressing their needs clearly for help is portrayed as they list challenges they face in their lives and how they depend on God to get solutions.

## Values
• Love: is nurtured as learners say how Jesus showed compassion to the widow.

## Pertinent and contemporary issues
• Social Justice: learners tell how they show kindness to others.

## Links to other learning areas
• English: reading skills are applied as learners read and learn new vocabulary.
• Creative Arts: creative skills are applied as learners sing a song about God’s power.

## Source
• KICD Grade 4 Christian Religious Education Curriculum Design (Revised 2024) — Strand 3.0 The Life of Jesus Christ, Sub-strand 3.5 Jesus raises a Widow's Son
• Luke 7:11-16; John 11:25

PAGE 2: Lesson 1: The funeral at Nain

LESSON 1: THE FUNERAL AT NAIN
=============================

## What you will learn
• Retell Luke 7:11-16.
• Explain how the story shows God's power over life and death.
• Recite John 11:25.

Curriculum outcomes: a) retell the story of raising the widow’s son; b) recognise God’s power over life and death

## Introduction
A funeral is a day of tears. At Nain, a widow was burying her only son. Jesus met that procession at the town gate and showed that death does not have the last word.

## Notes
Read Luke 7:11-16 and retell it carefully.

Soon afterwards, Jesus went to a town called Nain. His disciples and a large crowd went with Him. As He approached the town gate, a dead person was being carried out. The dead man was the only son of his mother, and she was a widow. A large crowd from the town was with her.

When the Lord saw her, His heart went out to her and He said, "Don't cry." He went up and touched the bier they were carrying the body on, and the bearers stood still. He said, "Young man, I say to you, get up!" The dead man sat up and began to talk, and Jesus gave him back to his mother.

The people were filled with awe and praised God. They said, "A great prophet has appeared among us," and "God has come to help His people."

### Power over life and death
The young man was dead. Jesus spoke, and he sat up and talked. People do not raise the dead. God does. The crowd was right to praise God. They saw that God had come to help His people.

John 11:25 is a word of Jesus to learn beside this story: "I am the resurrection and the life. The one who believes in me will live, even though they die." Resurrection means being raised to life. Write the verse on a flash card and recite it.

This miracle does not mean we should expect every funeral to end as Nain's did. It means Jesus has real power over death, and those who believe in Him have His promise of life. We still comfort people who are bereaved. We do not pretend that death is small. We trust the Lord who told the young man to get up.

## Key words
• widow — a woman whose husband has died
• bier — the frame on which the body was carried
• resurrection — being raised to life

## Activity: Read the story and the verse
You will need: Bible, Flash cards
1. Read Luke 7:11-16 and retell the story.
2. If a video clip on the raising of the widow's son is available, watch it and compare it with the verses.
3. Write John 11:25 on a flash card and recite it.
4. Say how the story shows God's power over life and death.
5. Sing a song about God's power over life and death.

## Practice
1. Who had died, and what was his mother's situation?
2. What did Jesus say to the young man, and what happened?
3. Recite John 11:25.

## Summary
• At Nain, Jesus met the funeral of a widow's only son.
• He told the young man to get up, and the man sat up and spoke.
• John 11:25: Jesus is the resurrection and the life.

### Answers to practice
1. The only son of a widow had died. The funeral was leaving the town of Nain.
2. He said, "Young man, I say to you, get up!" The dead man sat up, began to talk, and Jesus gave him back to his mother.
3. I am the resurrection and the life. The one who believes in me will live, even though they die.

PAGE 3: Lesson 2: Compassion and prayer in hard times

LESSON 2: COMPASSION AND PRAYER IN HARD TIMES
=============================================

## What you will learn
• Say how Jesus showed compassion to the widow.
• Show compassion to others and pray when facing challenges.

Curriculum outcomes: c) apply lessons learnt by showing compassion to others; d) pray to God when faced with challenges

## Introduction
Jesus did not pass the widow in silence. His heart went out to her. Compassion is that movement of the heart, followed by help. We can learn it, and we can pray when our own troubles come.

## Notes
Compassion means feeling someone's pain and acting to help. Luke 7:13 says that when the Lord saw the widow, His heart went out to her. He told her not to cry. Then He did more than speak. He touched the bier, raised her son, and gave him back to her. Compassion in this story is pity joined to power.

### Lessons for us
We do not have power to raise the dead. We do have ways to show kindness:

- Sit with someone who is sad and listen.
- Say a gentle word instead of laughing at tears.
- Help with a small task at a neighbour's home when a family is in trouble.
- Share food or a school item with a child who has lost support.
- Pray for the person.
- Tell a parent or teacher if a classmate is deeply sad or unsafe.

Social justice in a child's life includes this kindness. You do not ignore a person in pain.

### Praying when you face challenges
Challenges are hard things: sickness, lack of school needs, fear, a quarrel, or grief. List yours honestly. Then say how you involve God:

- Tell Him the problem in prayer.
- Ask for help, wisdom and comfort.
- Thank Him for the people who stand with you.
- Obey what is right while you wait.
- Remember John 11:25 when you are afraid of death: Jesus is the resurrection and the life.

The widow did not have to shout for Jesus to care. He saw her. You may still pray, because prayer is how you bring your challenge to the God who sees. Depend on Him for the solution, and accept the help of trusted adults.

## Key words
• compassion — feeling someone's pain and acting to help
• challenge — a hard situation in life
• grief — the deep sadness that comes when someone dies or a great loss happens

## Activity: Kindness and prayer
You will need: Exercise book, Bible
1. Say how Jesus showed compassion to the widow.
2. Tell how you show kindness to others.
3. List challenges you face and how you involve God.
4. Write a short prayer asking God for help with one challenge.
5. Recite John 11:25 and sing about God's power.

## Practice
1. How did Jesus show compassion to the widow?
2. Give two ways a learner can show compassion.
3. What should you do when you face a challenge?

## Summary
• Jesus' heart went out to the widow, and He gave her son back.
• We show compassion by kind words and helpful actions.
• We pray to God when we face challenges.

### Answers to practice
1. His heart went out to her, He told her not to cry, He raised her son, and He gave him back to her.
2. Any two: listen to someone who is sad, speak gently, help with a task, share food or a school item, pray, tell an adult if someone is unsafe.
3. Pray and tell God the problem, ask for help, and also seek help from trusted adults.
pages.quiz:
REVISION QUIZ — 3.5 JESUS RAISES A WIDOW’S SON
========================================

Answer all the questions, then mark yourself on the Answers tab.

1. The raising of the widow's son is told in:
   A. Luke 7:11-16
   B. Mark 10:46-52
   C. Luke 17:11-19
   D. Genesis 41:14

2. The town was...
   A. Nain
   B. Nazareth
   C. Jericho
   D. Harran

3. The dead person was...
   A. the widow's only son
   B. a Roman soldier
   C. a tax collector
   D. an angel

4. Jesus told the mother...
   A. "Don't cry."
   B. "Climb the tree."
   C. "Go to the priests."
   D. "Leave the town forever."

5. What happened when Jesus said, "Young man, get up"?

6. The crowd praised God and said...
   A. God has come to help His people
   B. the widow should stop praying
   C. death is stronger than God
   D. nothing unusual had happened

7. John 11:25 says Jesus is...
   A. the resurrection and the life
   B. a tax collector
   C. unable to help
   D. only a storyteller

8. God's power over death in this story is seen when:

9. Jesus showed compassion when...
   A. His heart went out to the widow and He helped her
   B. He walked past the funeral
   C. He told the crowd to be silent forever
   D. He sent the mother away

10. When you face a challenge you should...
   A. hide it from God
   B. pray and ask God for help
   C. laugh at people who cry
   D. refuse all kindness
pages.answers:
ANSWERS — 3.5 JESUS RAISES A WIDOW’S SON
========================================

1. A. Luke 7:11-16
   The class reads Luke 7:11-16.

2. A. Nain
   Luke 7:11 says Jesus went to a town called Nain.

3. A. the widow's only son
   Luke 7:12 says he was the only son of his mother, and she was a widow.

4. A. "Don't cry."
   Luke 7:13 records these words.

5. The dead man sat up and began to talk, and Jesus gave him back to his mother.
   Luke 7:14-15 describes the raising.

6. A. God has come to help His people
   Luke 7:16 records their praise.

7. A. the resurrection and the life
   The verse says, "I am the resurrection and the life."

8. Jesus raised the widow's son and the young man sat up and spoke.
   Only God's power can raise the dead.

9. A. His heart went out to the widow and He helped her
   Luke 7:13 says His heart went out to her.

10. B. pray and ask God for help
   The lesson teaches learners to pray when they face challenges.
